integrity: Symbolic proof gives the all-size theorem; a standalone enumerative checker independently compares direct traces, local criterion and binomial coefficients on sizes 3 through 8. A cycle-parity construction proves nonpure inclusion-maximal support families at all even orders at least six.
scientific_limitations: Only proper three-colourings of simple cycles, binary vertex-colour equality tests and named colours. No independent validation or absolute historical priority assertion. The already-known scalar VC dimension is not newly claimed.
title: Local-run classification and complete marked-query shattering polynomial for ternary cycle colourings
